context: Fill in the blanks in the following statements.
solution:
By the theorem of equal ratios, if \(\dfrac{a}{3} = \dfrac{b}{7}\) then each ratio equals \(\dfrac{4a + 9b}{4 \times 3 + 9 \times 7}\).
\(\therefore \dfrac{a}{3} = \dfrac{b}{7} = \dfrac{4a + 9b}{4 \times 3 + 9 \times 7} = \dfrac{4a + 9b}{12 + 63} = \dfrac{4a + 9b}{75}\)
\(\therefore\) the blank is 75.

context: Fill in the blanks in the following statements.
solution:
\(\dfrac{x}{3} = \dfrac{y}{5} = \dfrac{z}{4} = \dfrac{5 \times x}{5 \times 3} = \dfrac{-3 \times y}{-3 \times 5} = \dfrac{4 \times z}{4 \times 4}\)
\(\therefore = \dfrac{5x}{15} = \dfrac{-3y}{-15} = \dfrac{4z}{16}\)
\(= \dfrac{5x - 3y + 4z}{15 - 15 + 16}\)  ----(by the theorem of equal ratios)
\(= \dfrac{5x - 3y + 4z}{16}\)
\(\therefore\) the blank is 16.

stem: If \(\dfrac{a}{x - 2y + 3z} = \dfrac{b}{y - 2z + 3x} = \dfrac{c}{z - 2x + 3y}\) and \(x + y + z \neq 0\) then prove that each ratio \(= \dfrac{a + b + c}{2(x + y + z)}\).
solution:
Let \(\dfrac{a}{x - 2y + 3z} = \dfrac{b}{y - 2z + 3x} = \dfrac{c}{z - 2x + 3y} = k\).
\(\therefore\) by theorem of equal ratios
\(k = \dfrac{a + b + c}{(x - 2y + 3z) + (y - 2z + 3x) + (z - 2x + 3y)}\)
\(= \dfrac{a + b + c}{2x + 2y + 2z}\)
\(= \dfrac{a + b + c}{2(x + y + z)}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{a}{x - 2y + 3z} = \dfrac{b}{y - 2z + 3x} = \dfrac{c}{z - 2x + 3y} = \dfrac{a + b + c}{2(x + y + z)}\)

stem: If \(\dfrac{y}{b + c - a} = \dfrac{z}{c + a - b} = \dfrac{x}{a + b - c}\) then prove that \(\dfrac{a}{z + x} = \dfrac{b}{x + y} = \dfrac{c}{y + z}\).
solution:
By invertendo, we get
\(\dfrac{b + c - a}{y} = \dfrac{c + a - b}{z} = \dfrac{a + b - c}{x}\)
Now let \(\dfrac{b + c - a}{y} = \dfrac{c + a - b}{z} = \dfrac{a + b - c}{x} = k\).
\(\therefore\) by theorem of equal ratios
\(k = \dfrac{(c + a - b) + (a + b - c)}{z + x} = \dfrac{2a}{z + x}\) .....(I)
\(k = \dfrac{(a + b - c) + (b + c - a)}{x + y} = \dfrac{2b}{x + y}\) .......(II)
\(k = \dfrac{(b + c - a) + (c + a - b)}{y + z} = \dfrac{2c}{y + z}\) .....(III)
\(\therefore \dfrac{2a}{z + x} = \dfrac{2b}{x + y} = \dfrac{2c}{y + z}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{a}{z + x} = \dfrac{b}{x + y} = \dfrac{c}{y + z}\)

By observation, we see that multiplying by \(2x\) the predecessor and the successor of the right hand side, we get two terms of the predecessor and the successor of the left hand side. But before multiplying, we must ensure that \(x \neq 0\).
If \(x = 0\) then \(\dfrac{14x^2 - 6x + 8}{10x^2 + 4x + 7} = \dfrac{8}{7}\) and \(\dfrac{7x - 3}{5x + 2} = \dfrac{-3}{2}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{8}{7} = \dfrac{-3}{2}\), which is a contradiction.
\(\therefore x \neq 0\)
\(\therefore\) multiplying predecessor and successor of RHS by \(2x\) :
\(\dfrac{14x^2 - 6x + 8}{10x^2 + 4x + 7} = \dfrac{2x(7x - 3)}{2x(5x + 2)} = k\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{14x^2 - 6x + 8}{10x^2 + 4x + 7} = \dfrac{14x^2 - 6x}{10x^2 + 4x} = k\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{14x^2 - 6x + 8 - 14x^2 + 6x}{10x^2 + 4x + 7 - 10x^2 - 4x} = \dfrac{8}{7} = k\)
\(\therefore k = \dfrac{8}{7}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{7x - 3}{5x + 2} = \dfrac{8}{7}\)
\(\therefore 49x - 21 = 40x + 16\)
\(\therefore 49x - 40x = 16 + 21\)
\(\therefore 9x = 37\)  \(\therefore x = \dfrac{37}{9}\)
